title: Homeowner Loyalty Credit on Reissued Real Estate Plan Invoices
content:
**Credit rule.** A reissued plan invoice on a Real Estate Service Contracts order carries a homeowner loyalty credit worked out from the buyer's Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts contract in status active and the returned premium payments recorded on the buyer's homeowner contracts in the twelve months before the invoice date.

| Buyer's active homeowner contract | Returned premium payments in the twelve months before the invoice date | Homeowner loyalty credit |
|---|---|---|
| in its third or a later term | none | $22.50 for each completed term, the completed terms being the current term number less one |
| in its second term | none | a flat $40.00 |
| in every other case: in its first term, no active homeowner contract, or any returned payment in those twelve months | — | no homeowner loyalty credit |

The credit is a flat amount subtracted once from the reissued plan premium; the reissued plan premium is never below zero.

## The credit by term (hypothetical buyers with no returned payment)

| Current term of the active homeowner contract | Completed terms | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | none |
| 2 | 1 | $40.00 (flat) |
| 3 | 2 | 2 times $22.50: $45.00 |
| 4 | 3 | 3 times $22.50: $67.50 |
| 5 | 4 | 4 times $22.50: $90.00 |

A buyer in the fourth term with one returned premium payment eight months before the invoice date receives no credit.

## Records read

From the Homeowner Service Contracts records: the buyer's contract in status active and its term number, and the billing entries of the buyer's homeowner contracts recorded as returned payments, with their dates.
